versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the bulkpublish-get-analytics skill.
- Enables pulling analytics, engagement metrics, and performance data from BulkPublish, including post performance and engagement details.
- Supports overall analytics summary, single post metrics, plan quota usage, and listing posts for analysis.
- Provides detailed guidance on interpreting per-platform metric availability and reporting practices.
- Ensures metric accuracy by requiring supported metrics checks before reporting zeros.
